[[File:Undead Jed chathead.png|left]]
'''Undead Jed''' is the zombified form of [[Jed]], and the final boss fight of the [[Eye for an Eye (miniquest)|Eye for an Eye miniquest]]. Captured by [[The Harbinger]] after seemingly being devoured by [[Thalassus]], Jed was interrogated and tortured for failing to bring back his slave quota, and was zombified as a result, being turned into Undead Jed. Jed feigned being a defective undead so he could escape when the time was right, and fled to [[Cyclosis]] to enact revenge against [[Cap'n Ekahi|Lookout Ekahi]], who had betrayed him. During the miniquest, he takes some of Ekahi's soul in order to bolster his own, and is then killed by the [[player character]].

The battle against Undead Jed has a boss life bar, much like that of [[Araxxor]] and similar, but he almost certainly will die in one hit to the player (even unarmed) as he has essentially no defence and only 100 life points.

==Trivia==
* His examine text is a portmanteau of "zombie" and "Jed".
* He calls the player a dairy farmer, whilst the player comments that they aren't trading insults. This is a reference to 'Insult Sword Fighting' in ''Monkey Island''.
